profile.headline: Software Engineering Intern @ Forbes Advisor
profile.summary:
I am a recent Computer Science graduate from Bellevue College with a strong interest in software engineering and machine learning. 

I have completed academic projects applying ML techniques to real-world problems, including an AI-powered smart fridge system and improving heart rate prediction with wearable data. I also enjoy full-stack development, with experience in React, Django, Flask and SQL.

Through both academic and professional experiences, I have developed my problem-solving and collaboration skills. From contributing to task automation as a Software Engineering Intern to supporting marketing strategies at Beyond Vision Ltd. and impulze.ai, I have gained valuable experience working in diverse environments with cross-functional teams. I also love learning new skills and exploring emerging technologies. Currently seeking entry-level software engineering opportunities.

projects.title: AI Smart Fridge
projects.description: For our senior capstone project, I collaborated with two other students to develop an AI-powered smart fridge system designed to bring advanced smart features to any standard refrigerator, without requiring expensive smart appliances. The system is software-driven and highly flexible, making it compatible with a wide range of affordable hardware setups. Key features include real-time ingredient tracking using computer vision, automated meal suggestions based on dietary preferences, an integrated shopping list, and expiration date monitoring.

projects.title: Beezy - NextGen Startup Challenge
projects.description: As part of the NextGen Startup Challenge, a two-week hackathon-style competition hosted by Bellevue College and Keimyung University, our team developed Beezy, a freelance marketplace application designed to streamline project management for both freelancers and clients. Beezy simplifies the hiring process by allowing customers to recruit multiple freelancers for a single project, forming a collaborative team within the platform. The app centralizes communication, ensuring seamless coordination between clients and freelancers, making project management much more efficient.
